symptom: The unmerged v292 deny-only trust-policy preflight checked the settlement trust anchor's validity window only at the last FINAL revision. A synthetic earlier PROVISIONAL revision outside that key window could pass metadata consistency when the later FINAL was in-window. No independent proof, private evidence or production path was used.
lesson: A valid terminal correction does not retroactively validate earlier settlement revisions under an envelope-wide trust anchor. Checking only the last revision's key window permits out-of-window predecessor metadata to appear consistent, even though the evidence is untrusted and unscorable.
guardrail: For a settlement envelope that names one trust anchor for its correction chain, validate the anchor's issuer, role, state and validity interval at every revision observedAt, not only the terminal revision. Preserve a negative provisional-outside/FINAL-inside fixture and a positive all-inside fixture. Return independentAuthorityVerified=false and scoringAuthorized=false throughout; external attestation remains separately blocked.
